name: Small Quarter Ally
text:
**Small Quarter Ally**: Segadan halflings most often live in the Small Quarter alongside other people of similar stature, such as gnomes. A halfling with this racial trait grants herself and all allies of the same size category within 60 feet a +1 luck bonus on saving throws against fear effects.

This replaces fearless.
